messages.author: Edra
messages.content:
You might be seeing the multiplicative value instead of the additive value, which is how they were displayed before.

Imagine you have two sources of 50% fire resistance. Previously those two would add up in AUDIT to 100% (50% + 50%). That's not how the game actually calculates resists though.

messages.author: Edra
messages.content:
Instead the game calculates resists as a running total. I.E

1000 Fire Damage gets reduced by 50% to 500 Fire Damage.
That 500 Fire Damage then gets reduced by a further 50% to 250 Fire Damage.

The end result is only 75% fire resistance.

messages.author: Edra
messages.content: I believe you can AUDIT <damage type> directly to view the flat percentages for each defense and how that effects the running total.
